title: Prep Drill Log Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=prep:drill
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(drill_type) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many prep drill log events land each day and how many distinct drill type values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest prep drill log records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct drill type values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much prep drill log activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
